Analogy a comparison between two things, typically for the purpose of explanation or clarification The structure of an atom is like a solar system. 6c4814f76b386b7f24f4.text: action, to convince them of an idea through argument, or to reaffirm their existing beliefs. Examples of Texts That Are Written to Persuade: ▪

285503268ebafe205be9.text: Advertisements ▪ Campaign Speeches ▪ Persuasive Letters or Notes

e2593f760676898dea63.text: Compare and contrast is a rhetorical style that discusses the similarities and

7b862b297f396e03073a.text: differences of two or more things: ideas, concepts, items, places, etc. This is also used to make some kind of comparison to help illustrate a point.

99d50d5d34f34df445ad.text: A Venn diagram is used in making comparison and contrast to show

8bc164062d053a6d473a.text: differences and similarities of two subjects. It uses overlapping circles or other shapes to illustrate the logical relationship between two or more sets of items. Often, they serve to graphically organize things, highlighting how the items are similar and different.
